column23: The Fujifilm Instax Square SQ40 is a stylish analog instant camera that shoots square-format Instax film, featuring automatic exposure and a built-in selfie mode for easy, high-quality instant prints.
column24:
The Fujifilm Instax Square SQ40 is an analog instant film camera designed for creators who love the look and feel of square-format instant prints. Using Fujifilm Instax Square instant film, the SQ40 produces 1:1 square photos with a print size of 86 x 72 mm and an image area of 62 x 62 mm. Its classic, textured exterior and simple control layout make it both stylish and easy to use.

The camera features automatic exposure, so it detects ambient light and optimizes shutter speed and flash output for well-balanced images with minimal effort. A built-in selfie mode is activated by pulling out the lens to the second position, adjusting focus and exposure for arm’s-length shots and close-ups. A front-facing selfie mirror helps with framing.

With a fixed 65.75 mm lens (equivalent to approximately 28 mm in 35 mm format), the SQ40 is ideal for everyday snapshots, portraits, and social occasions. The camera supports a focus range from 0.3 m in selfie mode and from 0.5 m to infinity in standard shooting. It uses two CR2 lithium batteries, providing enough power for roughly 30 Instax Square film packs (about 300 shots) under typical use.

Designed for straightforward, point-and-shoot operation, the Instax Square SQ40 is well suited for parties, travel, events, and creative projects where tangible, square prints are part of the experience.
